title: Brain cells meant to protect us may be fueling cognitive decline
caption:
A decades-long study of human brain tissue reveals that cells responsible for insulating nerve fibers can malfunction with age, overproducing abnormal myelin and disrupting cognitive speed. Investigating the lost protective proteins behind this shift points toward treatments already used for other nerve disorders.

Source: Sciencedaily - Brain cells meant to protect us may be fueling cognitive decline
